title: The class of every verb of the bridge (Shared/VerbClasses.json in the bridge mod)
description: One place for what each GK.* function is: fair (a player could do it through the game itself), cheat (it sets the world, bends a rule, or cannot be shown to do neither) or observation (it reads). The mod reads it to refuse a verb a step's class does not allow; the host reads it for bg3_api and holds it to the functions the mod defines. docs/contracts/lua-api.md, "The class of a verb".

namespaces.description: A class for every function of a GK table that `verbs` does not name, those made at run time included (GK.Cheat's catalogue).

verbs.description: The path under GK (Act.Attack, Key) and its class.

why.description: What the verb does that makes it this class, where its name does not say.

needs.description: What the verb needs of the Script Extender beyond the stock build: a path under Ext that must be there (Events.Roll). Without it the verb answers { ok = false, error, needs } and does nothing.
